paragraphs: As well as emergency plumbing we also carry out small plumbing jobs and repairs — no call-out fees, same-day service.
Toilets that won’t flush, blocked toilets, dripping taps and burst pipes — emergency or not, we can help.

Looking for a reliable, local plumber in Leeds? Our team is here for you around the clock, providing fast and dependable emergency plumbing services with no call-out fee. Whether it’s a burst pipe, a blocked drain, or another urgent issue, we’re just a call away.

In addition to emergencies, we’re also small-job specialists. We handle everyday plumbing tasks like fixing dripping taps, repairing faulty toilets and sorting minor leaks. Our rates are quoted upfront with no hidden fees, and we aim to provide same-day service to get your plumbing back in working order as soon as possible.
Our Services in Leeds and Surrounding Areas:
Trust our BPEC-qualified plumbers with your plumbing in Horsforth, Adel, Rawdon, Cookridge, Wetherby, Calverley and beyond. Call now for fast, reliable service!
SMALL PLUMBING JOBS WITH SAME DAY SERVICE — NOT ALL LEEDS PLUMBERS ARE THE SAME
We carry out all general plumbing work and aim to arrive within the hour, wherever you are in Leeds. Small jobs can usually be done the same day.
Gas Safe registered engineers for boiler breakdowns, central heating repairs and replacements — often up and running again the same day.
We have the qualifications and most parts to get your unvented hot water cylinder repaired, usually the same day. We repair most brands including OSO, Range, Gledhill, Ariston and Megaflo.
All drains unblocked — toilets, manholes and sinks. High-pressure drain jetting and drain camera surveys, with a dedicated drain-jetting unit for blocked toilets and manholes.
We cover all areas including Tadcaster, Wetherby, York and every Leeds postcode.

We repair and replace lead water main supply pipes to your home or business. We are a WIAPS-certified company and members of WaterSafe, and can carry out the complete job including any excavation and reinstatement work.

If you need a new drain pipe, we can help. External soil stacks (soil and vent pipes) replaced — if you need your old cast-iron pipe from the toilet to the ground replacing with new plastic pipe, call us.

Outside your house, usually on the footpath, is an external stoptap. Sometimes it’s necessary to turn this off if the supply to your house is leaking, there’s a fault, or you need to replace the internal stoptap. Until May 2023 Yorkshire Water would attend for free to repair or replace the external stoptap, but their policy has now changed and they will not attend unless there’s an urgent risk to health, such as no water to the property or a confirmed serious internal leak. This makes our job more challenging, however we can often help by clearing the outside tap, fitting a new stop tap elsewhere, or using our pipe-freezing machine.
Yorkshire Water website here
DBS-checked plumber — certificate available.
We don’t expect to get paid until you’re satisfied with the work, and our invoices are itemised. No job too large or small.
We cover Leeds and the surrounding areas 24 hours a day, including Rothwell, Seacroft, Cookridge, Yeadon, Horsforth, Headingley, Morley, Wakefield, Wetherby, Boston Spa and Tadcaster.

We’ve been plumbing in Leeds for over 35 years, so rest assured you’re in safe hands. The business was established around 2000. If you need an emergency plumber in Leeds or Wetherby, call us any time — we provide a fast and reliable service to all areas. Remember, with no call-out charges you only pay from arrival.
We can usually attend the same day for emergency plumbing, leaks, dripping taps, and toilets overflowing or not flushing. For emergencies we usually arrive within the hour.

If you have a blocked drain or toilet, we have a drain-jetting van and our drainage engineer has over 40 years’ experience. We can also carry out a drain camera survey if required. We cover the entire Leeds area.

Not all plumbers are qualified, experienced, or hold a G3 certificate. At EmergencyMan we have qualified engineers who carry the most common spares in their vans, so we can often repair on the first visit.
We have a top-of-the-range pipe-freezing machine for those situations when you can’t turn the water supply off.

Mark’s journey into the world of plumbing began at the age of 14, immersing himself in the family business alongside his father and brother. His childhood home was above a bathroom shop. By 16, Mark was not only working full-time but also building his skills at Leeds College of Building, specialising in replacing outdated cast-iron baths with modern coloured bathroom suites. His early years were mainly spent installing bathroom suites and central heating systems in terraced houses, some of which had never had such amenities before.

Embarking as a self-employed plumber at 26, Mark joined Corgi, now known as Gas Safe. His expertise extended beyond plumbing as he carried out gas safety inspections across railway stations as well as properties all over Leeds. He also worked for a catering equipment company, fitting and maintaining commercial catering equipment.

By his mid-30s, Mark shifted his focus towards emergency repairs, working with national firms like Able, React Fast and Alliance. It was during this period, around the year 2000, that Emergencyman was born. Identifying a niche for swift, reliable and honest plumbing services, Mark established a brand that quickly became synonymous with excellence. To this day we still only cover Leeds and very nearby areas, as we find this offers the best service to our customers. Emergencyman.co.uk was one of the very first plumbing websites in Leeds, launched in 2002.

Over the years, Emergencyman has flourished, benefiting from a close partnership with Keith, a veteran of the drain-unblocking sector with 45 years of experience. Today the business runs a dedicated drain-unblocking van, a testament to its growth and specialisation.

Now in his 50s, Mark’s commitment to professional development remains unwavering. He recently achieved certification in water regulations and is fully qualified in unvented hot water systems, underscoring his dedication to staying at the forefront of the trade. Our bread and butter is still emergency plumbing.
Calls are answered by a dedicated team, as Mark believes it’s wrong to talk to another customer on the phone while doing work for a paying customer.

While Mark may not personally attend every call these days, his legacy of quality, integrity and customer satisfaction continues. Each member of the team carries the same standards and values on which Emergencyman was built, so every job is not just completed but a promise kept.

When temperatures drop in Leeds, frozen pipes quickly become one of the most common plumbing emergencies. A burst pipe can cause serious water damage and costly repairs — but most winter plumbing problems are preventable with a few simple checks. Below are our practical winter plumbing tips to help protect your home.
Every homeowner should know where their mains stop tap is. It’s often:
If you’re unsure, trace a cold water pipe backwards until you find the valve. If your property has a Yorkshire Water meter, you may also be able to shut off the supply there.
Important:

turn the stop tap gently to make sure it works. If it’s seized or stiff, it’s far better to deal with it now than during an emergency. If you can’t locate or operate your stop tap, call us on 0113 232 9556 and we’ll help.
The outside tap is the most common pipe to freeze. If your outside tap has an internal isolation valve:
If it can’t be isolated:
Be aware: in severe frost, insulation alone may not prevent freezing. We strongly recommend having an internal isolation valve fitted before winter.
A frozen condensate pipe is one of the biggest winter call-outs in Leeds. If your condensate pipe runs externally:
This often happens on the coldest days of the year. To reduce the risk:
If your boiler keeps cutting out during frost, we can advise and upgrade the pipework properly.
Older properties sometimes have water tanks or pipework in the loft. If you have:
then your loft pipework must be insulated correctly. Homes with modern combination boilers are less likely to have water pipes in the roof space — but it’s always worth checking.
If your toilet constantly trickles water into the pan, it’s more than just wasted water. In freezing conditions:
There’s no quick fix once a soil stack freezes — prevention is essential. If your toilet is running or “letting by”, we can repair it before winter causes a bigger issue.
Frozen pipes don’t happen every winter — but when we get a proper frost, plumbing emergencies increase dramatically. During severe cold weather:
The best approach is prevention. If you’d like a winter plumbing check or advice on protecting your pipework, call our Leeds plumbers on 0113 232 9556 before the freezing weather arrives.
